title: Use-case gallery — rule families at a glance

families.title: Module structure
families.description: Module / interface / package / program declarations plus their ports, params, and nets (S1, S2, S14–S16).

families.title: Continuous assign & dataflow
families.description: `assign` statements and the drives/reads edges they emit back to net symbols (S5, S6, S84).

families.title: Procedural blocks
families.description: `always_ff` / `always_comb` / `always` blocks plus their sensitivity lists (S7, S8, S9, S74–S76).

families.title: Instances & connectivity
families.description: Hierarchical instances + the `instantiates` / `of_module` / `connects` edges that wire them up (S3, S4, S69).

families.title: Assertions & SVA
families.description: Concurrent + immediate assertions plus named properties and sequences (S17–S20, S70–S72, S77, S78).

families.title: Covergroups
families.description: Covergroup containers + their coverpoints, crosses, and bins (S22, S23).

families.title: Classes & OOP
families.description: Class declarations, the methods/properties/constraints they own, and the extends/implements edges that link them (S24–S27, S82).

families.title: Packages, programs, types & interfaces
families.description: Packages, typedefs (forward + concrete), interfaces, clocking blocks, modports — the reuse layer (S30, S31, S32, S60, S62, S63, S85, S86).

families.title: Checkers & extern declarations
families.description: Checker blocks + checker instances + extern module/UDP declarations (S28, S29, S79–S81).

families.title: Nets, vars & user-defined nettypes
families.description: The net/var family — wires, logic, nettypes, user-defined nettypes (S4 + nettype rules).
